description: This Java source file defines the LabelManagerFactory class, responsible for managing label files, loading component names, parsing XML resource files, and providing label info within the Ofbiz web tools module. It includes methods for searching and updating localization labels for components.

classes.name: LabelManagerFactory
classes.description: A final class responsible for managing resource label files, loading component configurations, parsing XML files for labels, and providing access and modification methods for labels and their localization data within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getInstance()
methods.description: Singleton factory method that initializes component names and label files if not loaded, returning a new instance of LabelManagerFactory.

methods.name: loadComponentNames()
methods.description: Loads all component names into a static set from ComponentConfig.

methods.name: loadLabelFiles()
methods.description: Loads label resource files from component classpath info directories.

methods.name: findMatchingLabels(String component, String fileName, String key, String locale, boolean onlyNotUsedLabels)
methods.description: Searches for labels matching specified parameters in loaded XML resource files.

methods.name: getLabelFile(String fileName)
methods.description: Returns a LabelFile object for the given filename.

methods.name: getLabels()
methods.description: Returns a map of label information keyed by label key and filename.

methods.name: getLocalesFound()
methods.description: Returns a set of discovered locales.

methods.name: getFilesFound()
methods.description: Returns collection of all loaded label files.

methods.name: getComponentNamesFound()
methods.description: Returns set of all component names found.

methods.name: getLabelsList()
methods.description: Returns a set of label keys.

methods.name: getDuplicatedLocalesLabels()
methods.description: Returns the count of duplicated locale labels.

methods.name: getDuplicatedLocalesLabelsList()
methods.description: Returns a list of duplicated locale label info.

methods.name: updateLabelValue(List<String> localeNames, List<String> localeValues, List<String> localeComments, LabelInfo label, String key, String keyComment, String fileName)
methods.description: Updates or adds label values across multiple locales.
